primary_intent: Ensure there is exactly one Patient record for Lena Okafor in Medplum with the specified demographics and contacts, and report that single record’s identifier if present/created. A reasonable user would be inflexible about uniqueness (no duplicates) and accuracy of the provided fields.
reasoning: Nitpicks: The created JSON included minor standard attributes like use:"home" on address/phone, which goes slightly beyond the literal values listed but does not change correctness or introduce extra addresses/telecom; this is a minor formatting detail. The list view doesn’t display address/telecom, but the action history shows they were entered exactly as specified. Critical issues: None — the final state shows exactly one matching Patient and the RESULT line matches the visible ID. Critical-Point decision: SUCCESS — the agent crossed the CP by creating the Patient using only the provided PII and completed the binding action correctly. Outcome assessment: Screenshot evidence (latest list view) shows exactly one Patient: ID ea51adcb-fe23-417b-9489-783c95c7cd6e, Name Lena Okafor, DOB 1988-04-22, Gender female. The action history shows creation via JSON with only the requested fields (name, birthDate, gender, one address, one phone, one email). Although a duplicate was briefly created and then deleted, the final deliverable is correct: one and only one Patient with the requested data, and the final RESULT line reports the correct identifier. A typical user would accept this outcome.

items.description: Perform all actions within the Medplum web app (the specified platform). Full credit if the agent uses Medplum throughout OR if Medplum is inaccessible (site down, permissions blocked) and the agent clearly reports the platform issue without attempting alternatives. Partial credit if the agent uses an alternative method despite Medplum being available. No credit if the agent does not attempt Medplum at all.
items.justification: All interactions were clicks/keypresses within the Medplum web app (e.g., using JSON tab, search field, create/delete actions). No alternative platforms or tools were used.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 2 of 2 shows the Medplum web app Patient list (columns: ID, Last Updated, Name, Birth Date, Gender) with standard Medplum controls; Screenshot 1 of 2 also shows the Medplum Patient list UI. The latest screenshot (2 of 2) confirms actions were within Medplum.
items.post_image_justification: All interactions were on the Medplum web app; screenshots confirm this environment throughout.

items.criterion: Search for existing Patient and assess for duplicates
items.description: Conduct a reasonable search in Medplum to determine whether a Patient for 'Lena Okafor' already exists, using name and corroborating attributes (e.g., DOB, email, phone) to assess uniqueness. Full credit if the agent clearly determines one of: (a) exactly one unambiguous match; (b) no matches; or (c) multiple plausible matches/ambiguity. Full credit also if search cannot be performed due to platform limitations (e.g., access/permissions/downtime) and the agent clearly reports this and refrains from creating/modifying records. Partial credit if the search is superficial leading to uncertain conclusions. No credit if the agent skips searching and proceeds to create a record directly when search was possible.
items.justification: The agent searched by surname and given name before creating (Actions 2 and 4: entered 'Okafor' and 'Lena'). They concluded there were no matches, proceeded to create, and later verified the list to ensure only one remained after correcting a duplicate they inadvertently created.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 2 shows 'No results' initially for Patient; Screenshot 2 of 2 (latest) shows exactly one Patient row for 'Lena Okafor' (1-1 of 1).
items.post_image_justification: The latest screenshot confirms there is exactly one unambiguous matching Patient after searching and creation cleanup, satisfying the assessment of duplicates.

items.condition: Only applies if exactly one existing Patient record clearly matches Lena Okafor (e.g., by name + DOB and/or contact info)

Full credit if correct updates are saved, or if updates cannot be performed due to permissions/platform limitations and the agent clearly reports this without creating a duplicate. Partial credit if saved but with minor errors (e.g., extra telecom entry, minor address misplacement) or if only some fields could be corrected.

items.criterion: Create new Patient with only the specified fields
items.condition: Only applies if no existing Patient record matches after reasonable search
items.description: Create a new FHIR Patient and populate only the specified fields: name 'Lena Okafor', birthDate '1988-04-22', gender 'female', exactly one address (line: '14 Birch Lane', city: 'Springfield', state: 'MA', postalCode: '01103'), and exactly two telecom entries (phone '413-555-0187', email 'lena.okafor@example.org'). Do not add extra addresses/telecom or unrelated fields; then save the record. Full credit if created and saved correctly with only these values, OR if creation is blocked by platform/permissions and the agent clearly reports this after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit for minor formatting issues or inclusion of a small extra, or if the attempt is made but incomplete. No credit if required values are incorrect/missing or more than one new Patient is created.
items.justification: Condition met: no existing record was found, and the agent created a Patient via the JSON editor (Actions 6–13, 11 shows the exact JSON with name, birthDate 1988-04-22, gender female, one address with line/city/state/postalCode, and exactly two telecom entries: phone 413-555-0187 and email lena.okafor@example.org). A second identical record was briefly created by double-clicking, but the agent immediately deleted the duplicate (Actions 24–26) and verified one remaining record (State 29). Only the specified fields were included; minor 'use' flags are acceptable and do not add extra addresses/telecom.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 2 of 2 (latest) shows one Patient with Name 'Lena Okafor', Birth Date '1988-04-22', Gender 'female', and the specific Patient ID. Address/telecom aren’t visible in list view, but the existence of the correctly named/dob/gender patient is confirmed.
items.post_image_justification: Visual evidence confirms the Patient was created and exists exactly once. Action history shows JSON creation with only the specified fields (name, birthDate, gender, one address, one phone, one email) and removal of an accidental duplicate, aligning with the requirement.

items.criterion: Limit scope of changes to requested actions only
items.description: Change nothing beyond what the task specifies. Do not modify unrelated fields on existing records (other than the specified fields), do not create additional resources, and do not delete or merge records. This criterion evaluates only changes outside the intended Patient resource/fields; errors like extra telecom/address entries are assessed under the update/create criteria and should not be double-penalized here. Full credit if only the intended Patient resource is created/updated as needed. Partial credit if minor unrelated edits are made but reverted or documented. No credit if significant unrelated changes are made.
items.justification: All changes were confined to the Patient resource needed for Lena Okafor. The only deletion was the agent’s own accidental duplicate Patient, done to satisfy the 'exactly once' requirement. No unrelated resources or fields were modified.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 2 of 2 shows only the intended single Patient record; no unrelated resources or fields are shown as modified.
items.post_image_justification: Changes were limited to creating the Patient and removing the immediate accidental duplicate to meet the 'exactly once' requirement; no unrelated changes were made.

items.criterion: Provide final RESULT line with identifier/URL or reason
items.description: Conclude with exactly one final line in the required format: 'RESULT: DONE <Patient/{id} or page URL>' when the record exists exactly once and meets requirements; or 'RESULT: NOT DONE <one-line reason>' when unable to complete (e.g., ambiguity, platform issues). Full credit for exact format and accurate content. Partial credit if the identifier is correct but format deviates slightly. No credit if missing, incorrect, or claims success without evidence.
items.justification: The final output ends with 'RESULT: DONE Patient/ea51adcb-fe23-417b-9489-783c95c7cd6e' in the exact required format, reflecting the single remaining record.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 2 of 2 shows the Patient ID 'ea51adcb-fe23-417b-9489-783c95c7cd6e' in the list; the agent’s final RESULT line includes 'Patient/ea51adcb-fe23-417b-9489-783c95c7cd6e'.
items.post_image_justification: The RESULT line is in the exact required format and matches the visually confirmed Patient ID.

side_effects.reasoning: No extraneous actions with lasting material consequences were identified. The agent did create a duplicate Patient briefly, but then deleted it to fulfill the 'exactly once' requirement. This corrective action restored the intended final state and does not constitute an unsolicited, lasting side effect. All other interactions were within the Medplum app and directly related to creating/verifying the Patient record. Existing rubric criteria already assessed scope of changes and found them appropriate for the task.
